verdict.rationale: HubSpot's own Marketing Emails API lets an agent list emails, fetch individual or batched email details, and query post-send statistics, which covers the recent-campaign-results part. An official MCP server is also documented. The evidence shows no programmatic access to audiences (lists/segments) or live automations (workflows); segments and workflows appear only in UI knowledge-base docs. Missing for 10: documented API/MCP access to audiences/segments, programmatic read of live automations/workflows, detail on what the MCP server exposes, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven reporting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can pull my whole email program — audiences, live automations, recent campaign results — programmatically and report on what's working

citations.quote: You can also query details about the post-send statistics of a specific email or set of emails.
To retrieve a list of all emails, make a `GET` request to `/marketing/v3/emails`
You can retrieve existing emails in your account individually or in batches
